frame_selection: Inherited independent edit reference manifest contains keyframes0/8/15 before R4 scoring. These are all existing independent edit-GT anchors, not selected using candidate outcomes.
evaluation_unit: each reconstruction configuration separately; M0 and hybrid8 share one physical ancestor
route_contract: one frozen route hash reused across every frame, camera and operation; q read only by executor

reference_variant.geometry: independent first-hit semantic used for evaluation ROI only; single controlled vehicle semantic10

reference_masks.new_body: edited_body; includes overlap with original body
reference_masks.keep: NOT(original_body OR edited_body), all image pixels including environment/no-hit
reference_masks.validity: zero-area ROIs are unavailable and are omitted from that per-frame target mean with denominators recorded; all expected frames/operations still mandatory

primary_target.pixel_metric: mean absolute RGB error after clipping prediction to [0,1]
primary_target.normalization: each nonempty old_vacated/new_body ROI separately over pixels and3channels; equal ROI weights; equal frame weights; equal delete/shift/rotate weights
primary_target.none_role: hard preservation constraint only, not a target gain
primary_target.raw_metrics: parallel unclipped RGB errors retained; no raw-range guarantee inferred

development_constraints.definitions: At every anchor and edited q separately: keep MAE(h,GTq)-keep MAE(allkeep,GTq), and fraction of keep pixels whose mean-channel absolute-error increase exceeds0.02. At every anchor: raw-RGB mean absolute change of actual-route none versus actual allkeep none.
development_constraints.calibration_status: explicit provisional development constraint, not calibrated deployment safety or sealed-test threshold
development_constraints.invalid_outputs: missing expected row, mismatched frozen route/context, nonfinite arrays or compositor failure invalidate complete-domain oracle

constraint_sensitivity.selection: descriptive only; do not replace primary0.005 according to outcomes

finite_gap.requires: all8 frozen routes and all3anchors x4operations valid in same native evaluation domain; at least one safe route; allkeep parity and actual modified-route none validated
finite_gap.unsafe_route: gap unavailable; separate violations and unconstrained objective delta reported
finite_gap.name: finite-domain decision gap under declared development constraints on3existingGTanchors
finite_gap.not_claimed: global optimum; full16/49frame optimality; learned policy generalization

capability.best_verified_shared_residual: report J of same best safe shared route and its per-operation losses
capability.completion_bin: C?; no calibrated task completion threshold
capability.single_operation_optima: optional posthoc diagnostic only; cannot splice route states across operations

real_scene: No independent complete counterfactual edit GT. Report actual none preservation and output validity; D finite regret and C counterfactual residual unavailable. Require verified target-to-native-dynamic-row mapping before editing; no all-dynamic fallback.

eligibility.f_geom: unknown until legal full-scene contribution near measured-depth support is implemented
eligibility.f_bg: unknown until legal historical revealed-domain ray matching
eligibility.other: legal azimuth support and field consistency are proxies; do not fill formal P=1 from scorer GT

depth_and_temporal_metrics: unavailable until explicit native-depth and correspondence contracts; not silently zero-filled

learning_boundary.current: two observed physical ancestors; only one procedural world has complete independent edited reference
learning_boundary.allowed_small_check: same-world held-out time/camera engineering signal check labeled G0, or fully transparent leave-configuration-out diagnostic; no cross-world claim
learning_boundary.minimal_independent_expansion: add at least two separately generated procedural world/asset ancestors for train and calibration alongside existing world as held-out development. Lock splits before reconstruction and action scoring; same renderer/sensors/checkpoint budget and frozen H0 recipe. This3-ancestor result is only a small feasibility check, no population-level generalization claim.
